name: Indian FMC Championship 2026
information:
**YOU MUST INCLUDE THE LOCATION YOU ARE ATTENDING IN YOUR REGISTRATION COMMENT AND FILL THE REGISTRATION FORM GIVEN IN THE REGISTRATION PAGE.**

The competition will be held in multiple locations across India, and there is a separate fee for each city. For more information, refer to [locations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianFMCChampionship2026#77698-locations) tab.

Locations may be added until September 13th 08:30 AM IST. If there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates#asia-west-south).

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

The winner of FMC will be crowned as the FMC National Champion 2026, and prizes will be awarded to the participant in the upcoming [Indian Elite Championship 2026](IndianEliteChampionship2026).
